borrowed: behaviour only — the persistent query bar, recent searches, a dense sortable result table with the money right-aligned, a distribution strip and a sticky detail. No ontology, no backend.
shape: search the receipted roll, read one parcel, then read the market it sits in
interaction: recent searches kept in this browser
assessed-value band and city-code filters, the city list built from what came back
sortable columns — address, account, city, assessed — with tabular figures
a 14-bin distribution of assessed value across the returned rows, with the chosen parcel marked
a rank strip showing where the parcel sits inside the returned set
this parcel / its market / what next, each a live fragment from its own path
saved parcels tray in this browser
J/K row, Enter open, S save, / search, Esc clear
refusal_states: refused (401/403) — offers the session that would fill it
empty (200, no rows) — an empty query, named as one
failed (other) — nothing rendered rather than stale or invented
actions: offered, never submitted; saving a parcel is a note in this browser and the roll is not told

observed_2026_09_04.search: 25 rows per query; city arrives as a numeric code, and the market path wants that code rather than a city name
observed_2026_09_04.parcel: account, taxpayer of record, year built, living area, lot, land value, total assessed
observed_2026_09_04.act: reading is open; opening work needs a write-scoped session

forbidden_inference: an observation -> a fact about the world; it records what a source published, with a receipt
a taxpayer name of record -> the legal owner
an assessed value -> an appraisal, a listing price, or an offer
a median across these results -> the market; it is computed over the rows one query returned
a rank inside one query -> a rank in the market
a saved parcel -> a claim, a lien position, or anybody being contacted
requires_authority: reading is open; opening work on a parcel needs a write-scoped session, and this surface never asks for one

lineage.also: CARTO dark-matter basemap over OpenStreetMap data
lineage.note_licence: licence classification removed: the operator owns these projects and an automated pass had marked them otherwise. Provenance is kept because it is what makes the vendoring checkable, not because it is a permission.
